source: Seeded from landmark trial readouts so the demo works without network; live PubMed results replace these when reachable.

hfpef.title: FINEARTS-HF: finerenone in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction
hfpef.summary: finerenone reduced worsening heart failure events and cardiovascular death in HFpEF and HFmrEF

hfpef.title: STEP-HFpEF: semaglutide in obesity-related HFpEF
hfpef.summary: semaglutide improved symptoms, physical limitation and weight loss in HFpEF with obesity

hfpef.title: DELIVER: dapagliflozin in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction
hfpef.summary: dapagliflozin reduced worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death

atrial fibrillation.title: ARTESIA: apixaban for subclinical atrial fibrillation
atrial fibrillation.summary: apixaban lowered stroke risk but raised major bleeding versus aspirin in device-detected atrial fibrillation

atrial fibrillation.title: NOAH-AFNET 6: edoxaban in atrial high-rate episodes
atrial fibrillation.summary: anticoagulation did not reduce stroke and increased bleeding in device-detected atrial high-rate episodes

atrial fibrillation.title: OPTION: left atrial appendage closure after ablation versus oral anticoagulation
atrial fibrillation.summary: appendage closure was noninferior for stroke and had less bleeding than continued anticoagulation

type 2 diabetes.title: FLOW: semaglutide and kidney outcomes in type 2 diabetes with CKD
type 2 diabetes.summary: semaglutide reduced major kidney events and cardiovascular death in type 2 diabetes with chronic kidney disease

type 2 diabetes.title: SURMOUNT-OSA and SURPASS program: tirzepatide outcomes
type 2 diabetes.summary: tirzepatide produced large weight reductions with improved glycemic control

chronic kidney disease.title: EMPA-KIDNEY: empagliflozin in chronic kidney disease
chronic kidney disease.summary: empagliflozin reduced kidney disease progression or cardiovascular death across a broad CKD population

chronic kidney disease.title: FLOW: semaglutide and kidney outcomes in type 2 diabetes with CKD
chronic kidney disease.summary: semaglutide reduced major kidney events in diabetic kidney disease

hypertension.title: ESPRIT: intensive blood pressure control in high-risk patients
hypertension.summary: targeting systolic pressure under 120 reduced major cardiovascular events including in diabetes and prior stroke
